The 4OMe curves and their induction landmarks

147 catalysed · 49 enzyme-free

Every live 4OMe cuvette in the archive, both channels, in experiment order. The rust line is whichever form the curve earned from summary_kinetics.fit_progress, and the dashed vertical is the induction landmark — the first crossing of half the largest rolling slope (induction.induction_point). Nothing is excluded.

Read the two blocks against each other. That is the folder's first claim and it is a contrast: 91 of 151 catalysed curves accelerate past 3σ and 0 of 49 enzyme-free ones do, the largest z in that block being 2.25 — over runs as long as 17934 s. A curve with no induction still gets a landmark, because dropping those rows is the censoring the statistic exists to avoid; its footer says so through the depth.

The landmark's window is a tenth of the run, so it is safe within a run and not between runs — two panels of different duration carry landmarks read through different windows. Each panel prints its duration for that reason, and every between-run comparison in ANALYSIS.md uses something that is not windowed.
